bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
tmp="$(mktemp -d)";trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py "$tmp/original.py"
python3 - "$tmp/original.py" "$tmp/updated.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,sys
s=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
old='''                                raw = [screen.reply_markup.rows[i].buttons[1] for i in range(3)]'''
new='''                                raw = [getattr(screen.reply_markup.rows[i].buttons[1], "button",
                                               screen.reply_markup.rows[i].buttons[1]) for i in range(3)]'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
ast.parse(s)
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(s)
PY
cp "$tmp/updated.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
chmod 600 scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 3
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
timeout 40s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 72
python3 - <<'PY' | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
import sys,asyncio,re
sys.path.insert(0,"scripts")
from userbot_test_client import invoke
r=asyncio.run(invoke("invite_selector_smoke"))
print("INVITE_COPY_UNWRAPPED_TEST")
print("STATUS="+str(r.get("status")))
print("ERROR="+re.sub(r'[^A-Z0-9_]','_',str(r.get("error","NONE")).upper()))
types=r.get("button_types")
if isinstance(types,list) and len(types)==3:
 print("UNWRAPPED_TYPES="+",".join(re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_]','_',str(t))[:60] for t in types))

if isinstance(flags,list) and len(flags)==3:print("HAS_COPY_FIELDS="+",".join(str(x) for x in flags))
print("NATIVE_COPY_BUTTONS="+str(r.get("native_copy_buttons","NOT_VERIFIED")))
PY
